info.title: WolvenKit.CLI
info.description: Command line modding tool for Cyberpunk 2077.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Sets the verbosity level of the command. Allowed values are q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], and diag[nostic].

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.description: Search pattern (e.g. *.ink), if both regex and pattern is defined, pattern will be prioritized.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Regex search pattern.

options.description: Dump archive json for diff.

options.name: --list
options.description: List all files in archive.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Input archives path. Can be a file or a folder or a list of files/folders.
